_doc: Register form validation (RegisterPage: valid phone + password >= 8 + matching confirm; consent enforced on submit). Buttons are never disabled for validation (2026-07-12); an invalid submit flags the offending field inline (aria-invalid, or consent-error for the checkbox) and stays on /register; the login-error Alert is server-errors-only. 'valid' rows are asserted enabled but never clicked (no account created).

consentCase.note: with consent unchecked the button stays ENABLED, but clicking flags consent-error and never leaves /register (no OTP request is sent)
